beats.text: Glass on top. Wires under it feel your finger.
Next, the battery. It stores energy, and it's the biggest part.
In one very thin phone, it's two thirds of the inside.
The brain is a tiny chip that does the thinking.
One popular chip has 19 billion tiny on-off switches.
The camera turns light into numbers.
The radio talks to cell towers and Wi-Fi.
Put it back together, and that's your phone.
Follow for more, and see how everything works.
